Quirk-Fit Tuning.name: Quirk-Fit Tuning
Quirk-Fit Tuning.description: The user retunes their own or an ally's costume or support gear to how that wearer's Quirk behaves in use: venting heat, damping recoil or feeding fuel more smoothly. The next Quirk technique the wearer uses this scene counts one Strain step lower: severe to heavy, heavy to moderate, moderate to light. Cost: none.
